facts.fact: APAnews reports that Malian e-money operator SAMA Money, already authorised to offer BCEAO PI-SPI services, activated reception of PI-SPI instant transfers in a customer notice made public on 13 November 2026.
APAnews reports that new BCEAO tariff provisions in force since 2 November 2026 cap the fees charged on certain electronic payment operations.
APAnews reports that Mali's SAMA Money customers can receive transfers through the BCEAO PI-SPI platform, including from other UEMOA countries, from 13 November 2026.

MLI.note: Only a fee cap is mentioned; no payments law or e-money rules on who may issue or connect are stated.

facts.fact: APAnews reports that Malian e-money operator SAMA Money has an e-wallet service with customers able to receive funds from 13 November 2026.
APAnews reports that SAMA Money wallets receive instant transfers from banks and other providers connected to the BCEAO PI-SPI, free and at any hour.
